completeness.why: The new getRangeScheduleAmount covers only the midpoint arithmetic; forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions each keep their own null/number/range dispatch, which the existing getScheduledAmount already decides in full, so they are partial (rubric anchor). The budget template's halved-rounded-sum copy is untouched, preserving that inconsistency by leaving it out rather than carrying it as an explicit variation, so it is none.

interface.why: Adds a second narrow helper for only the range case next to the existing getScheduledAmount that already decides missing/number/range, so callers still own the dispatch; the template's rounding inconsistency is not made explicit as a parameter but simply left at its site.

disguised_duplication.where: The null/number/range dispatch stays verbatim (not reshaped) in four sites, duplicating getScheduledAmount's own dispatch; it is left in place rather than disguised.
